label: lose the last digit of an entFiltNum coefficient
why: -3.8513500390114781 and -3.8513500390114780 are the SAME double, 0xc00ecf909bf8055f both.  Seventeen significant digits already exceeds what a double distinguishes here, so the last one carries no bit.  Kept because it is the natural first mutation to write and the answer -- that these literals sit at the round-trip boundary and a one-digit edit cannot move them -- is what the next person needs.
